Subject: Redwood discovery — pilot options & next steps

Hi Dana — great to connect today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery and the suggested next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Proof-of-concept to reduce per-inference cost and stabilize 99th percentile latency for BrightPath's patient messaging feature.
- Success criteria: <=150ms P99 for 256-token gen, <=40% cost reduction vs current hosted approach, and no PHI touching Redwood control plane (private keying/edge routing).
- Proposed pilot: 2-week dedicated pool on us, sample workload of nightly batch + live pilot with 10% traffic.

Requests from your side:
- A sanitized sample of the token distribution and a short csv of typical prompt/response pairs (we only need a small representative sample).
- Confirmation on procurement timing and any legal constraints for a short evaluation (SLA not required for trial).

I've attached a short mutual action plan with dates and ownerships. If you can confirm pilot dates by EOD Friday (10/23), we can spin up staging capacity the week of 10/26.

If procurement needs a ballpark estimate first, we can provide a templated one — I just need to know target monthly token volume and whether you prefer on-prem/private deployment options.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 15-min call to iron out procurement owners if helpful.

—Laura
